description: Helper functions for accessing FINRA API data related to weekly summaries, specific symbol data, date adjustments, and short interest dates.

methods.name: get_finra_weeks(tier: str = "T1", is_ats: bool = True)
methods.description: Fetches available weeks from FINRA based on tier and ATS flag.

methods.name: get_finra_data(symbol, week_start, tier: str = "T1", is_ats: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves FINRA data for a specific symbol, week, tier, and ATS flag.

methods.name: get_full_data(symbol, tier: str = "T1", is_ats: bool = True)
methods.description: Aggregates full data for a symbol across all relevant weeks from FINRA.

methods.name: get_adjusted_date(year, month, day)
methods.description: Returns the closest weekday date if the given date falls on a weekend.

methods.name: List[str] get_short_interest_dates()
methods.description: Generates a list of dates for which short interest data is available, adjusted for weekends.

ctags.name: get_finra_data
ctags.pattern: /^def get_finra_data(symbol, week_start, tier: str = "T1", is_ats: bool = True):$/
ctags.signature: (symbol, week_start, tier: str = "T1", is_ats: bool = True)

ctags.name: get_full_data
ctags.pattern: /^def get_full_data(symbol, tier: str = "T1", is_ats: bool = True):$/
